SELECT
  i.status AS invoice_status,
  COUNT(*) AS total_invoices,
  COUNT(i.voided_at) AS voided_at_populated,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.voided_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS voided_at_null,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM audit_log a
      WHERE a.entity_table = 'invoices'
        AND a.entity_id = i.id
        AND a.tenant_id = i.tenant_id
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matching_audit_log_rows,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM audit_log a
      WHERE a.entity_table = 'invoices'
        AND a.entity_id = i.id
        AND a.tenant_id = i.tenant_id
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
  , 1) AS coverage_rate_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.tenant_id) AS distinct_tenants
FROM invoices i
WHERE i.status IN ('void', 'uncollectible')
GROUP BY i.status
ORDER BY total_invoices DESC, invoice_status
note: Counts all invoices with status in ('void','uncollectible') regardless of voided_at, splits them into voided_at populated vs null, and separately counts how many of those invoices have at least one matching audit_log row (entity_table='invoices', entity_id=invoices.id, same tenant_id) via EXISTS, which is also the basis for the coverage rate.
